NEAN_DIRECIONAL.Dica: Tokens drawn at 45°: every move or turn (Shift/Ctrl + mouse wheel) uses the pose of the nearest diagonal. One image per direction is enough, armed or unarmed; if a direction is missing, the token shows the nearest one available.
NEAN_DIRECIONAL.Ativar: Enable image swapping on this token
NEAN_DIRECIONAL.PastaResultado: {n} of {total} images found by file name.
NEAN_DIRECIONAL.TambemPrototipo: Also save to the actor's prototype token (applies to its new tokens)

statusCaido.dica: IDs of the conditions that show the down image, comma separated (Foundry default: dead, prone, unconscious).

statusFurtivo.dica: Besides the module's Stealthy condition, other IDs from your system that count as stealthy, comma separated.

statusArmado.dica: Besides the module's Weapon drawn condition, other IDs from your system that count as armed, comma separated.

NEAN_DIRECIONAL.SemPermissaoEnviar: You are not allowed to upload files (ask the GM: Settings → Permissions → Upload files).
NEAN_DIRECIONAL.DicaArrastar: You can drag images from your file explorer: one onto a slot goes to that slot; several at once are matched by name. The images are copied into the world folder.

Lista.Dica: Opens a list of every actor in the world, searchable by name; click an actor to set up its prototype token images.

Manual.Dica: How to set up the images, use them at the table and name the files.
